## Definition of done

- [ ] Branch is named `<type>/<issue#>-<slug>` and the title is a Conventional Commit
- [ ] `npm run check`, `npm run typecheck`, `npm run lint:arch` and `npm run test` pass locally
- [ ] Atomic design and import rules respected
- [ ] Accessible: keyboard navigation, focus states, contrast, reduced motion
- [ ] Copy exists in FR, EN and DE
- [ ] Docs, stories and tests updated where relevant
